facts.founders_experience: Glean was founded by former Google executives with deep expertise in search, AI, and enterprise software. The founding team includes Arvind Jain (CEO), a former Distinguished Engineer at Google with over 15 years of experience in search and infrastructure, and T.R. Vishwanath (CTO), who previously led engineering teams at Google and built large-scale distributed systems.

key_leaders.name: Arvind Jain
key_leaders.title: Co-Founder & CEO
key_leaders.background: Former Distinguished Engineer at Google; led search infrastructure and AI initiatives.

key_leaders.name: T.R. Vishwanath
key_leaders.title: Co-Founder & CTO
key_leaders.background: Former Google engineering leader; built large-scale distributed systems and enterprise search platforms.

key_leaders.name: Howard Lerman
key_leaders.title: President
key_leaders.background: Former CEO and Co-Founder of Yext; extensive experience in enterprise SaaS and go-to-market strategies.

facts.deployment_scale: Glean is deployed across large enterprises with thousands of users, supporting global workforces. The platform integrates with over 100 enterprise applications and handles millions of queries per month.

capabilities: Unified workplace search across apps and documents

facts.gap_notes: Training may be required for administrators and end-users to maximize adoption.

facts.ramp_time: 2-4 weeks for administrators; 1-2 weeks for end-users

integration_requirements: Enterprise SaaS applications (e.g., Slack, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Salesforce)
Identity providers (e.g., Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace)
Document and content repositories (e.g., SharePoint, Box, Dropbox)
facts.complexity_notes: Pre-built connectors and APIs streamline integration, but custom configurations may require additional effort.

facts.support_model: Documentation, professional services, and customer support

facts.monetization_model: Subscription-based SaaS (per-user pricing with enterprise contracts)

facts.gtm_model: Direct sales and partner-led (enterprise sales motion with a focus on large organizations)

facts.contracting_notes: Enterprise contracts with custom pricing and terms; no public pricing available.
facts.pricing_governance: Tailored to enterprise needs, with discounts for larger deployments.

facts.fit_notes: Strong fit for large enterprises with complex knowledge management and search needs.
